dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Crenulated perimeters with high-contrast transitions from dark (exterior) to light (interior) intensity. Notable 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit variable edge thickness and irregular circularity on the mid-posterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of irregular, non-gradient light pixel clusters in the anterior dorsal region. These blobs show high core pixel intensity with minimal internal spatial frequency variation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent posterior 'O' rings define an obtuse scalene triangle. A separate group of four anterior high-intensity blobs forms a non-equilateral quadrilateral pattern.
